principles.title: Specific beats endless.
principles.body: One relevant person, with a reason to meet—never a public list to work through.

principles.title: Both sides choose.
principles.body: A proposed pairing moves forward only after two private yeses. Passing stays private too.

principles.title: Private, always.
principles.body: Names, contact details, and the exact meeting point unlock only when both sides accept.

about.scopeNote: For founders, investors, potential co-founders, and startups with a concrete reason to meet. Not for dating, job seeking, expo-hall pitching, or general networking.

process.heading: From “tell me your side” to “here’s when you’re meeting.”
process.body: Lane is a human operator—not a matching engine, feed, or booking marketplace. The process stays the same; the two sides change.

items.question: Is Lane only for founders looking for investors?
items.answer: No. The service is deliberately two-sided: investors use Lane to find founders, founders use Lane to find investors, potential co-founders find each other, and startups find another startup with a plausible customer or collaboration fit.

items.question: Is Lane a matching app?
items.answer: No. A human operator reads the intake and proposes one pairing at a time. There is no public deck, swipe feed, attendee directory, or automated matching engine.

items.question: Will everyone see my details?
items.answer: No. Intake stays private. Each proposed introduction is shown only to the two relevant sides, and direct contact details stay hidden until both accept.

items.question: What if I pass on a proposed pairing?
items.answer: Lane records the pass privately and moves on. The other side is not given your contact details, and there is no public rejection or ranking.

items.question: What happens after both sides accept?
items.answer: Lane confirms a time and a table or quiet corner. You receive two names and the exact location only after both yeses are in.

items.question: How does the meeting guarantee work?
items.answer: The guarantee applies to the track selected at signup: three accepted meetings on the current event calendar, or the founder-side fee is refunded. Lane books the meeting, not the round, co-founder, customer, or deal.
